title: FBLS: Preliminary Catalog of Exoplanet Transit Candidates Identified in TESS Photometry
description: Candidates from a blind transit search (FBLS, https://github.com/isakruas/fbls) of TESS 2-minute SPOC light curves. Every signal went through automated vetting, a difference-image pixel test and TRICERATOPS false positive probabilities; CTOI stars were re-searched on every sector available. Preliminary: dispositions may change in later versions.
